The focus is on the overwhelming scale of the event and the atmosphere of controlled chaos, rather than on any single main subject. The streets and bridges are completely gridlocked with an immense traffic jam of cars, while vast crowds of people on foot swarm the sidewalks and riverbanks, all seemingly attempting to leave the city.
